block.comment: Original 115200-baud raw ADC/F telemetry; no new capture protocol.
F=10: hold. Left/right: original proportional steering. F=0: hold 40 loops, then stop. Otherwise forward. No latched stop or new route strategy.
Position weights: A4=-1, A3=0, A2=+1. Integer proportional inner PWM; minimum5.
Exclude A1 and A5 from decisions; control uses A4/A3/A2 only.
Read all five ADCs; preserve original raw telemetry.
Three-center-sensor baseline rewrite. A4/A3/A2 control only; A5/A1 raw telemetry. PWM100, threshold70, TURN_KP75. Button waits at boot only. LED behavior unchanged.
